$comment: Every verdict janus verify gives a pact and the contract janus upgrade converts it into differently, each with what accounts for it: the staged-plan item that closes it, or the ADR that says why the conversion cannot say what the pact does. `verifier-diff run` fails on one not listed here, and on an entry nothing disagrees on any more. Staged plan S1.19; plan-grammar spec section 4.4.
